profile.headline: AWS Full Stack Developer at Virtual Service Operations
profile.summary: Java full-stack developer with 25+ years of experience spanning defense, financial services, and logistics. Holds an Active Secret Clearance and a proven record of rapidly mastering new technologies, diagnosing complex production defects, and mentoring junior engineers into high-performing contributors. Consistently delivers across diverse stacks — from Oracle PL/SQL and Java EE to Python/Django and Adobe Experience Manager — adapting quickly with each engagement.

positions.title: NISS Software Developer/SW Engineer Sr Principal
Lead Developer
positions.description: Leads a team of 6 Developers. Responsible for assigning and overseeing their work. Designing and constructing software solutions using Adobe Experience Manager including Adaptive Forms, Workbench, and Designer; Java custom components; and, JavaScript.

positions.title: Senior Programmer/Analyst
positions.description: Maintained and enhanced hybrid Java/HTML5/AngularJS/Good Dynamics/Android application and downstream Java based REST web service that consumed REST and SOAP web services.

positions.title: Subject Matter Expert-Solution Architect
positions.description: Analyzed business requirements to determine application impact.  Proposed technical solutions to satisfy business requirements.  Created POC and prototype database objects.  Created high level design.  Assisted in detail design.

positions.title: Application Architect
positions.description: Responsible for development and support of Oracle Database containing customer data used for credit card, debit card, and gift card information and the in-house Java servlet application.  This application grew from three screens to more than 20.  Responsible for composing and maintaining UNIX/Linux scripts on the database server.  Executed multiple database server migrations.  Responsible for the development, implementation, and maintenance of a Java servlet front end/Oracle database backend web application used by large customers to add locations for credit, debit, and gift card processing; and, the Java based application that migrated the orders to the boarding workflow application.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: Wrote reports in Sqribe, converted these reports to Oracle PL/SQL.  Maintained Oracle Forms frontend application.  Wrote and executed SQL and PL/SQL scripts.  Wrote and maintained UNIX scripts on database server.  Executed database server migrations.
